description: This file defines the AWS ChimeSDKIdentityClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Chime SDK Identity service, including creating, deleting, describing, listing, and updating app instances, users, and related resources.

classes.name: ChimeSDKIdentityClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Chime SDK Identity service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: createAppInstanceAdmin
methods.description: Creates a new admin for an app instance.

methods.name: createAppInstanceBot
methods.description: Creates a new bot for an app instance.

methods.name: createAppInstanceUser
methods.description: Creates a new user for an app instance.

methods.name: deleteAppInstanceBot
methods.description: Deletes a bot from an app instance.

methods.name: deleteAppInstanceUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from an app instance.

methods.name: deregisterAppInstanceUserEndpoint
methods.description: Deregisters an app instance user endpoint.

methods.name: describeAppInstanceUserEndpoint
methods.description: Describes an app instance user endpoint.

methods.name: getAppInstanceRetentionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves retention settings for an app instance.

methods.name: listAppInstanceUserEndpoints
methods.description: Lists user endpoints for an app instance.

methods.name: listAppInstanceUsers
methods.description: Lists users for an app instance.

methods.name: putAppInstanceRetentionSettings
methods.description: Sets retention settings for an app instance.

methods.name: putAppInstanceUserExpirationSettings
methods.description: Sets expiration settings for an app instance user.

methods.name: registerAppInstanceUserEndpoint
methods.description: Registers an app instance user endpoint.

methods.name: updateAppInstanceUserEndpoint
methods.description: Updates an app instance user endpoint.
